messages.content: What is the current time in Sydney, Australia?

function.name: get_local_time
function.description: Retrieve the local time for a specific city.

location.description: The city to get the local time for.

format.description: The format of the time to be retrieved, either 12 hours or 24 hours.

timezone.description: The timezone of the location. If left blank, the function will default to the city's local timezone.
